notes: BPJT embeds allStreams in its page HTML; there is no API (/api/cctv, /cctv/api, /api/v1/cctv and /cctv/data are 301 or 404).
BPJT carries coordinates, KM marker, road and operator — the only source that geolocates any toll camera. But its table has not been rewritten since 2026-05-11.

Jasa Marga has rotated every stream id since then: zero of its BPJT URLs appear on the Bina Marga pages, and they play 0/10 where Bina Marga plays 10/10. Jasa Marga is 61% of the usable cameras, so the road pages are not optional.
Bina Marga road pages carry current stream URLs and a KM label, and no coordinates. The transform joins them to BPJT on (road, KM) — 100% matched on Jakarta-Cikampek.
LIVENESS IS JUDGED ON THE BODY. jmlive.jasamarga.com answers HTTP 200 with zero bytes for a camera that is not publishing; a status-code pass scored 68% and was measuring nothing.
Known dead hosts: stream.bsdtol.com, and pub2.hk-opt.com is mostly dead.
No video is stored — only that a camera exists, where, and that it was publishing.
